Repeat the independent single-image photographic test using the supplied portrait as visible adult face and hair appearance guidance, with one independently seeded complex scene and pixel-level review.

A cinematic yet documentary photograph inside a small radio telescope control cabin during a dusk power test. One fictional adult stands beside a waist-high brushed-metal console, with visible adult face and hair appearance guided by the attached portrait: a soft oval face, dark eyes, and a short dark bob with loose wispy bangs. The adult wears a charcoal utility overshirt over a plain crewneck. Their right hand grips and turns a large red knurled power selector on the near edge of the console, with the wrist, forearm, elbow, and shoulder forming a relaxed reachable chain. Their left palm holds a paper checklist flat on the console beside the selector; both hands, the paper, and the selector are fully visible in the same frame. A short row of amber status lamps illuminates in sequence above the turned selector while the adult glances down at the readings, face in clear three-quarter view. Beyond the cabin window, the pale curved structure of a radio dish rises against a violet blue evening sky. Reflections of the amber lamps appear faintly on the window glass while the exterior dish stays readable through it. A cool dusk glow shapes the face and hair, and warm console light falls locally on the fingertips, red selector, and worn metal surface. The photograph has believable scale, tactile edges, subtle surface wear, natural optical depth, and a precise instant of cause and response. Frame from console height with a restrained medium portrait composition that keeps the action and the dish in view.
